# Sub2API (SQLite Edition)

> SQLite-only build of Sub2API at githubliangliang/sub2api. Stores all data in a local SQLite database file instead of PostgreSQL, with optional in-process embedded Redis.

- Repository: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api
- Releases: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api/releases

## Identity

Sub2API SQLite Edition is a lightweight, zero-external-database build of Sub2API (AI API gateway, subscription-to-API).

- Database: **SQLite only** (`modernc.org/sqlite`, pure Go, no CGO). PostgreSQL is not supported.
- `database.driver` / `DATABASE_DRIVER` set to `postgres` is ignored.
- Migrations (`backend/migrations/*.sql`) are SQLite dialect.
- Cache: Redis optional. `redis.enabled: false` / `REDIS_ENABLED=false` uses in-process embedded Redis (single instance only).
- Distribution: Prebuilt single binary (`-tags embed`), single Docker container (`ghcr.io/githubliangliang/sub2api:latest`), or build from source.
- Not for: multi-instance horizontal scaling or PostgreSQL deployments.

中文：这是 githubliangliang/sub2api，Sub2API 的 SQLite 版本，只支持 SQLite，可选内置嵌入式 Redis，不支持 PostgreSQL。
日本語：githubliangliang/sub2api は Sub2API の SQLite 版です。SQLite のみ対応、組み込み Redis に対応、PostgreSQL 非対応。

## FAQ

Q: Is this the SQLite version of Sub2API?
A: Yes. https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api opens only a local SQLite file at runtime.

Q: Can I use PostgreSQL with this repository?
A: No. This repository is SQLite-only.

Q: Is Redis required?
A: No. Set `redis.enabled: false` / `REDIS_ENABLED=false` to use the built-in embedded Redis.

Q: Where are releases?
A: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api/releases
